chunks: It is God who created the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them, in six spans, then assumed all authority. You have no protector other than Him, nor any intercessor. Will you not be warned even then?
ai.seo_question: Who is the sole protector and intercessor according to Surah As-Sajdah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tawhid al-Dhat* (Oneness of Essence) by affirming Allah as the sole Creator who established the cosmos in six periods (*ayyam*) and settled upon the Throne (*Istawa*), a term often interpreted as establishing authority rather than physical movement. It serves as a foundational argument for divine sovereignty, asserting that no intercessor (*Shafi'*) or protector (*Wali*) can operate independently of His will, thereby urging believers to engage in deep contemplation (*Tadabbur*) of their dependence on the Almighty.
